tools.name: check_profanity
tools.description: Detect English profanity in text (word list with leetspeak, look-alike letters, repeated letters, dotted/spaced letters and hidden characters handled) and return the matched terms, their positions (UTF-16 start/end in your text) and, unless censor is false, a censored copy of the same length. Common

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_profanity · Public sink: check_profanity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_profanity · Public sink: check_profanity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
